titulo: French minister invites UK to ‘come all the way back’ to the EU
cuerpo: Finance minister, Roland Lescure, welcomes Burnham’s pledge to explore closer ties with bloc Europe live – latest updates The French finance minister has invited the UK to “come all the way back” to the European Union after Andy Burnham raised the prospect of a new referendum to reverse Brexit. Roland Lescure was speaking after the prime minister used his Labour conference speech to pledge that the government would explore closer ties with the bloc at a summit later this year.
